scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply dktv-sync --local && wrangler dev
scripts.dev:test: wrangler d1 migrations apply dktv-test --local -c test/browser/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev -c test/browser/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply dktv-sync --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.check: npm run build && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test
scripts.bench: npm run build && esbuild bench/cpu.ts --bundle --alias:cloudflare:workers=./test/cloudflare-workers.ts --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.bench/cpu.mjs --log-level=warning && node .bench/cpu.mjs
